story: Sophie is in the garden. Sophie has a red chair and a little table. Sophie is making a crown with yellow flowers. [emotion:QT/surprised] A tiny fairy lands on the table! The fairy has bright purple wings. The fairy is holding three small flowers. Sophie puts the flowers on the crown. Now the crown is big and beautiful. [emotion:QT/happy] [gesture:clapping] The fairy claps her hands. Sophie and the fairy are sitting in the garden together. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie is smiling and the fairy is smiling too.
